No production validation or timeout was relaxed; final full-file reruns are authoritative.

limitations: Current object/backend association is not a permanent authenticated origin policy or Registry cutover.
Existing v1 shadow composition remains available; enforced/Review/Pilot/Promotion origin gates are still pending.
V2 readback may recover an already authorized WAL suffix and is not a no-write or atomic dispatch snapshot.
Local callback keys and persisted retention fixtures do not certify production WORM, source independence, quality, actual cost or cleanup.
Candidate/release markers remain v1. Upgrading them requires authenticated writer exclusion, cross-store recovery and explicit compatibility for old artifact bytes.
